cacheHint.note: cache by the JCS-canonical policy_parameters hash only; never by wall-clock or session

description: Recomputes and checks a checklist run: every step receipt's execution_hash, the hash-chain link between consecutive steps, and (if a run_receipt is supplied) the §20.1 RFC 6962 Merkle root over every step. Returns valid:true/false, per-step ok/hash_ok/link_ok, and broken_at (the zero-based index of the first broken step, or null). Same recompute a human gets from the browser Run Verifier.

run_receipt.description: The run receipt to check the Merkle root and its own execution_hash against. Omit to check only the step chain.

step_receipts.description: Ordered array of step receipts, as returned by checklist_step_receipt.

name: checklist_verify_run
title: Verify a checklist run's hash chain and Merkle root
